abstract: The chest radiographs and CT scans of 200 patients with pure testicular seminoma were reviewed. The radiographs showed evidence of intrathoracic metastatic disease in 25 patients (12.5%). Of these, 17 had an abnormal mediastinal contour, seven had pulmonary metastases, five had pleural effusions, and two had discrete pleural masses. CT showed evidence of intrathoracic metastatic disease in 30 patients (15%). This included mediastinal nodal enlargement in 21, pulmonary metastases in 12, pleural effusions in six, and pleural masses in two. CT not only showed disease in five patients with normal chest radiographs, but also showed additional sites of disease in four other patients with abnormal chest radiographs. The results suggest that mediastinal nodal enlargement is the most common intrathoracic manifestation of metastatic testicular seminoma. CT is more accurate than chest radiography in the detection of metastatic seminoma in the chest and defines the extent of metastatic disease more precisely.
abstract_ja: 純粋型精巣セミノーマと診断された200例の胸部X線写真とCTを検討した。X線写真では25例(12.5%)に胸腔内転移の所見があった。そのうち17例は縦隔輪郭の異常、7例は肺転移、5例は胸水貯留、2例は限局性胸膜腫瘤であった。CTでは30例(15%)に胸腔内転移が認められ、縦隔リンパ節腫大が21例、肺転移が12例、胸水貯留が6例、胸膜腫瘤が2例であった。CTはX線写真で正常と判定された5例で病変を示し、さらにX線写真で異常であった他の4例では追加の病変部位を示した。結果は、縦隔リンパ節腫大が転移性精巣セミノーマの胸腔内所見として最も多いことを示唆する。胸部X線写真よりもCTは胸部における転移性セミノーマの検出により正確であり、転移病変の範囲をより精密に定義する。
